Rugs USA Bot · AI says:

Here’s a quick rundown of our return and refund policy:

Return window (US, HI, AK): Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, in the same condition as received. Bedding must be unused in original packaging.
Non-returnable items:
Items marked final sale
Used/laundered bedding or bedding not in original packaging
Orders delivered to Canada or Puerto Rico
Custom by Rugs USA Collection products
Canada: For now, we do not accept returns on orders shipped to Canada.
How returns work: Returns must be shipped using a Rugs USA-provided label. Each item needs its own label.
Refund options: You can choose store credit or a refund to your original form of payment (for eligible orders). Store credit never expires and can be used on rugsusa.com and rugsusa.ca.
Return shipping fees:
Paid by the customer and deducted from your refund.
The fee is shown when you request a return and is per item.
BOGO orders: If you return an item from a buy-one-get-one promotion, the refund is adjusted to reflect non-promotional pricing of the item you keep.
ShopPay installments:
Partial return: Affirm updates your statement and payment schedule.
Full return: Affirm refunds payments already made and cancels future payments.
Timing for refunds:
After your return is delivered, allow 5–10 business days for us to process it.
Then allow your bank/credit card 5–7 business days to show the refund.
Why you might not see a full refund:
Return shipping fees are deducted.
There is a fee per returned item.
Exchanges: We don’t offer direct exchanges, but you can select store credit and then place a new order.
If a return can’t be processed online, common reasons include: final sale items, Canada/Puerto Rico delivery, Custom Collection rugs, or orders older than 30 days.

To start a return, head to our portal: https://rugsusa.loopreturns.com/#/ .

If you feel your refund amount is incorrect, you’re encouraged to contact our Customer Support team via chat or email as noted in the policy.

If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, we’re on it. We ask that you:

Contact our Customer Service team right away and let us know what’s going on.
Provide clear photos/images of the issue via live chat or email so we can properly review and resolve your claim.

For approved damaged/defective claims, return shipping fees can be handled through that claim process—however, if items are just sent back through the standard returns process without an approved damage claim first, we can’t refund those return shipping fees.

If you also purchased a separate Mulberry protection plan with your rug, you can file a warranty claim for covered damage by logging into your Mulberry portal, selecting the product, clicking “File a Claim”, and submitting the incident date, photos of the damage, and a brief description before sending it in.
